source.author: verg
source.text: Quin etiam caeli regionem in cortice signant, ut, quo quaeque modo steterit, qua parte calores Austrinos tulerit, quae terga obverterit axi, restituant: adeo in teneris consuescere multum est.
source.text_original: Quin etiam caeli regionem in cortice signant, / ut, quo quaeque modo steterit, qua parte calores / Austrinos tulerit, quae terga obverterit axi, / restituant: adeo in teneris consuescere multum est.
source.text_english: Indeed, they even mark the region of the sky on the bark, so that, in whatever way each tree had stood, by what side it had borne the southern heats and which back it had turned to the axis, they may set it back: so much does it matter to become accustomed while still young.

reuse.author: hier
reuse.text: Rursum si aliquid de veteribus libris respondero, et dixero, adeo in teneris consuescere multum est: dum renuo, crimen incurro, et pro me testimonium proferens, hoc ipso arguor, quo defendor.
reuse.text_original: Rursum si aliquid de veteribus libris respondero, et dixero, adeo in teneris consuescere multum est: dum renuo, crimen incurro, et pro me testimonium proferens, hoc ipso arguor, quo defendor.
reuse.text_english: Again, if I reply with something from the old books and say that so much depends on being accustomed from one’s earliest years, while I refuse, I incur a charge, and by producing testimony in my defense I am accused by the very thing by which I am defended.
